messages:
olivia: Quick sync — we should lock the joint 'Annex' playbook for the catalog listing. Need owners for: press snippet, hero asset, tenant staging slot, SI runbook. Who can take which?
raj: I can own tenant staging slot + cutover checklist. Will need staging credentials from eng by Fri.
sara: I’ll do press snippet + headline sync with PR. Can someone share the 90-char blurb we want on the marketplace tile? :thinking_face:
tom: @sara drafting now. Tentative blurb: "Redwood Inference: predictable, low-latency LLM inference across cloud and private deployments." thoughts?
sara: 👍 good start. Can we shorten to 75 chars for some placements? I'll iterate.
lia: I'll take hero asset approvals and localization checklist. Need final hero by Tue EOD. Who's doing photography vs. illustration?
anna: Design can do illustration. ETA for first pass: Mon morning.
kevin: Eng note — I'll hand off staging creds to @raj. Also flag: SI integration test harness needs a quiet window on Wed 01:00–03:00 UTC for onboarding tenant traffic.
raj: noted. Team, is the SI onboarding doc here? https://redwood.app/s/si-onboard (draft)
olivia: yes that's the draft. @deploy-bot can you remind infra to reserve the slot and add an incident line?
deploy-bot: infra: scheduled maintenance reservation created for Wed 01:00–03:00 UTC. Pager roster: eng-oncall, si-oncall.
sara: Press timeline: PR wants final quote + embargoed asset 48h before publish. We need quote from partner legal and from our SOC by Tue noon.
kevin: I'll loop in security (cc: @kevin) — can share SOC blurb by Mon.
lia: Quick checklist I'm tracking: 1) hero assets (design) 2) locale copies (i18n) 3) tenant staging slot (raj) 4) SI runbook (tom) 5) press blurb (sara) 6) legal signoff (kevin).
raj: Adding a short runbook snippet for the SI: ```
- preflight: ensure tenant X routed to staging
- smoke: 10 requests/min for 15m
- rollback: route back to control pool
- contacts: raj, tom, si-pm@example.com
```
sara: thanks — PR will want the live URL for embed. Can we pin a staging shortlink?
kevin: I'll create a shortlink once staging is live.
olivia: Action items summary (very small):
- sara: final press blurb + 75/90 char variants — due Mon 4pm
- anna/design: hero asset first pass — Mon 9am
- raj: staging slot + creds + runbook updates — Tue 6pm
- kevin: legal/SOC quote — Tue noon
- tom: SI runbook and test window coordination — Tue EOD
If we hit these, we should be clear for embargoed publish Thu morning. Any blockers? :eyes:
anna: no blockers from design.
kevin: legal wants to see exact wording for any customer success claims — will review once blurb is in.
tom: SI asks for a small schema spec for tenant registration — can someone paste it here?
raj: Pasting minimal schema: ```{ "tenant_id": "string", "region": "string", "auth_token": "jwt" }``` quick and dirty.
sara: perfect. I'll include that in the PR attachments.
olivia: Great. I'll run a short rehearsal on Wed 16:00 UTC with PR, eng, SI, and partners. Invite to follow. Thanks all :pray:
